scenarios.title: A shower or a front?
scenarios.objective: Bring both cars home while making your own crossover calls.
scenarios.hint: Watch cloud and surface trends. Compare keeping the fitted tyres, changing now and waiting; a shower and a lasting front may reward different calls. No rain arrival or winner is scripted.

scenarios.title: Drying unevenly
scenarios.objective: Manage a wet start and learn when local wet sections outweigh a drying line.
scenarios.hint: Rain-prone does not guarantee later drying. Engineers compare public observations when no binding plan exists. Inspect all three sectors and take manual pit ownership when you have a different risk preference.

scenarios.title: Rain is not the road
scenarios.objective: Learn the difference between falling rain, retained surface water and tyre choice.
scenarios.hint: Explicit legacy training schedule: wet conditions ease as this race progresses. The public forecast does not read the schedule; results still depend on actual decisions, traffic and physical stops.
